description: Latency and error drill-down for Envoy Gateway. Counterpart to the NGINX / Ingress controller / Request handling performance dashboard. Breakdowns are per Envoy cluster (HTTPRoute rule) because Envoy's default stats have no method/host/path dimension.

panels.description: Total time the client waited, measured at the HTTP connection manager.
panels.title: Downstream Request Latency Percentiles

panels.description: Time spent waiting on the backend. The gap against downstream latency is Envoy-side overhead plus client body transfer.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le)(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_time_bucket{gateway_namespace=~"$gateway_namespace", gateway=~"$gateway", pod=~"$pod", envoy_cluster_name=~"$route"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le)(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_time_bucket{gateway_namespace=~"$gateway_namespace", gateway=~"$gateway", pod=~"$pod", envoy_cluster_name=~"$route"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le)(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_time_bucket{gateway_namespace=~"$gateway_namespace", gateway=~"$gateway", pod=~"$pod", envoy_cluster_name=~"$route"}[5m])))

panels.title: Upstream Response Latency Percentiles

panels.description: Envoy's default stats carry no method/host/path dimension, so the finest available breakdown is the cluster — one per HTTPRoute rule.
panels.title: Request Rate by Route

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, envoy_cluster_name)(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_time_bucket{gateway_namespace=~"$gateway_namespace", gateway=~"$gateway", pod=~"$pod", envoy_cluster_name=~"$route"}[5m])))

panels.title: Median Upstream Response Time by Route

targets.expr: sum by (envoy_cluster_name)(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_xx{gateway_namespace=~"$gateway_namespace", gateway=~"$gateway", pod=~"$pod", envoy_cluster_name=~"$route", envoy_response_code_class=~"4|5"}[5m])) / sum by (envoy_cluster_name)(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_xx{gateway_namespace=~"$gateway_namespace", gateway=~"$gateway", pod=~"$pod", envoy_cluster_name=~"$route"}[5m]))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, envoy_cluster_name)(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_time_bucket{gateway_namespace=~"$gateway_namespace", gateway=~"$gateway", pod=~"$pod", envoy_cluster_name=~"$route"}[5m])))

panels.title: P95 Upstream Response Time by Route

targets.expr: sum by (envoy_cluster_name, envoy_response_code_class)(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_xx{gateway_namespace=~"$gateway_namespace", gateway=~"$gateway", pod=~"$pod", envoy_cluster_name=~"$route", envoy_response_code_class=~"4|5"}[5m]))

panels.title: Error Rate by Route and Class

panels.description: pending_overflow means the circuit breaker's max_pending_requests was hit — the request never reached the backend.
panels.title: Retries, Timeouts and Rejections by Route

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le)(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_cx_connect_ms_bucket{gateway_namespace=~"$gateway_namespace", gateway=~"$gateway", pod=~"$pod", envoy_cluster_name=~"$route"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le)(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_cx_connect_ms_bucket{gateway_namespace=~"$gateway_namespace", gateway=~"$gateway", pod=~"$pod", envoy_cluster_name=~"$route"}[5m])))

sum(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_cx_connect_ms_sum{gateway_namespace=~"$gateway_namespace", gateway=~"$gateway", pod=~"$pod", envoy_cluster_name=~"$route"}[5m])) / sum(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_cx_connect_ms_count{gateway_namespace=~"$gateway_namespace", gateway=~"$gateway", pod=~"$pod", envoy_cluster_name=~"$route"}[5m]))
